# Motion

> Motion is an experiment in body-controlled games where an iPhone reads
> movement on-device and turns it into game input.

Canonical URL: https://motion.significanthobbies.com/

## When to use this

- Best fit: body-controlled games where an iPhone reads movement on-device and turns it into game input
- Best fit: screen-mirroring phone gameplay to a larger display without uploading camera frames
- Not a fit: cloud-based motion capture or remote pose processing
- Not a fit: games that require transmitting or storing camera frames

## Product

- Audience: people interested in games and new ways to play
- Mechanism: iPhone camera -> on-device Apple Vision pose extraction -> game input
- Display: game renders on the phone and may be mirrored to a larger screen
- Privacy: camera frames are neither transmitted nor stored
- Status: prototype; not downloadable or publicly playable
- Evidence: browser game and iOS host implemented; simulator compile and launch verified
- Outstanding: physical-iPhone tracking, mirroring, joint mapping, and recording validation

## Important boundaries

- The public website is a landing page, not the game.
- The internal game, relay, room codes, and camera mode are not public.
- Motion has no public pricing, customers, testimonials, App Store release, or production-readiness claim.
